Open-source tools from my lab. Featured projects are curated below; the full list updates automatically from [GitHub](https://github.com/piketremor).

## Featured

| Project | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| [MEForLab](https://github.com/piketremor/MEForLab) | R package | Lab forestry functions — inventory, growth, and stand metrics |
| [GreenTimbMerch](https://github.com/piketremor/GreenTimbMerch) | R package | Kozak taper merchandising for NE/Acadian species |
| [forestinv](https://glc5xc-mike-premer.shinyapps.io/forestinv/) | Shiny app | Field inventory: BAPA and TPA from plot tallies |

## All public repositories

```{=html}
<div id="repo-list" class="repo-grid"><p>Loading repositories…</p></div>
<script>
(async () => {
  const el = document.getElementById('repo-list');
  const esc = s => (s || '').replace(/[&<>"]/g, c => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]));
  try {
    const r = await fetch('https://api.github.com/users/piketremor/repos?per_page=100&sort=pushed');
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status);
    const repos = (await r.json()).filter(x => !x.fork && !x.archived && x.name !== 'piketremor.github.io');
    el.innerHTML = repos.map(x => `
      <div class="repo-card">
        <h4><a href="${x.html_url}">${esc(x.name)}</a></h4>
        <p>${esc(x.description) || '<em>No description</em>'}</p>
        <div class="repo-meta">
          ${x.language ? `<span>${esc(x.language)}</span>` : ''}
          ${x.stargazers_count ? `<span>★ ${x.stargazers_count}</span>` : ''}
          <span>Updated ${new Date(x.pushed_at).toLocaleDateString()}</span>
        </div>
      </div>`).join('') || '<p>No public repositories found.</p>';
  } catch (e) {
    el.innerHTML = '<p>Couldn\'t load repositories. <a href="https://github.com/piketremor?tab=repositories">View them on GitHub</a>.</p>';
  }
})();
</script>
```
